title: TreexClans
body:
![Banner](https://i.imgur.com/HbWSEty.jpeg) **Clan System Plugin** – Advanced clans plugin for Minecraft servers with clan wars, rankings, clan homes, shared storage, PvP battles, invites, leaderboards, economy support, and customizable settings. Perfect for SMP, PvP, Factions, and survival servers. Lightweight, optimized, easy to set up, and fully configurable for modern Minecraft networks. [![DISCORD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60fcf5a0b12f3cff46b065aea871b3f08629f94e.png)](https://dsc.gg/jmdev)[![DONATE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a1b54c640e2f990880107e8bf3cd6c573a9201a.png)](https://ko-fi.com/jetby)
Spoiler It took me a massive amount of time to build this project. I would be incredibly happy if you could support my work—whether with a small donation, or simply by leaving a review or liking the project. 🙄👉👈
| **Dependencies**| | |:-|-| | **Libb** | [Download](https://modrinth.com/plugin/libb) | | Vault | [Download](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) | | Java 21 or higher | | Paper or forks | | Minecraft Version 1.20 or higher | # Addons: - [Leaderboard](https://modrinth.com/plugin/clanleaderboard) - [Glow](https://modrinth.com/plugin/clanglow) - [Quests](https://modrinth.com/plugin/clanquest) - [Events](https://modrinth.com/plugin/clanevents) # Features - Customizable — fully configurable with custom functionality support. - GUIs — create unlimited custom interfaces. - Addons — supports add-ons and ready-made extensions. - Technology — uses modern solutions such as MiniMessage and Libby. - Support — active bug fixing and community-driven improvements. - Economy — includes a clan bank system for deposits and upgrades. - Clan Coins — earn and spend coins on perks and rewards. - Levels — level up clans to unlock more members, storage, and bank capacity. # Images

Placeholders | Placeholder | Description | Example | |----------------------|--------------------------------------------|--------------------| | `%clan_tag%` | Clan tag | | | `%clan_id%` | Clean clan tag | | | `%clan_prefix%` | Clan prefix | | | `%clan_coin%` | Clan coins | | | `%clan_slogan%` | Clan slogan | | | `%clan_balance%` | Clan balance | | | `%clan_level%` | Current clan level | `1, 2, 3...` | | `%clan_level_name%` | Name of the current clan level | | | `%clan_exp%` | Current clan EXP | | | `%clan_exp_max%` | EXP required to reach the next level | | | `%clan_leader_name%` | Leader name | | | `%clan_rank%` | Rank display name (not ID) | | | `%clan_isLeader%` | Whether the player is the leader | `true / false` | | `%clan_` | Des |
Commands | Command | Description | |---------------------------------|--------------------------------------------| | `/clan create ` | Create clan | | `/clan accept ` | Accept invitation | | `/clan deny` | Deny invitation | | `/clan leave` | Leave clan | | `/clan invite ` | Invite to the clan | | `/clan kick ` | Kick from the clan | | `/clan disband` | Delete the clan | | `/clan menu` | Open the main menu | | `/clan chat` | Toggle chat | | `/clan chat ` | Send message without toggling the chat | | `/clan pvp` | Toggle pvp | | `/clan balance` | Clan balance | | `/clan deposit` | Deposit to bank balance | | `/clan withdraw` | Withdraw from bank balance | | `/clan base` | Teleport to the base | | `/clan setbase` | Set clan base | | `/clan setrank ` | Change member rank |
